show.description: Raj sacrificed his career, identity, and self-respect to become the perfect house husband for his ambitious CEO wife, Riya. But while he devoted his life to raising their daughter alone, Riya humiliated him, ignored her own child, and showered love on her ex-boyfriend and his son instead. After years of heartbreak and betrayal, Raj finally decides to walk away but this broken house husband is not as powerless as everyone believes, and his revenge is about to destroy the world.
